overview_description.description:
CareStack is a single all-in-one platform on the cloud that combines dental practice management, patient engagement, practice marketing, and data analytics. CareStack is currently used by large and growing practices as an all-in-one solution to increase productivity, minimize costs, and improve patient dental care. 

CareStack's mission is to help dentists to have a better practice and a better life. Through their technology-led offerings, CareStack will elevate dental offices to a higher degree of financial success.

product.name: CareStack Dental Practice Management Software
product.description: A cloud-based platform that integrates scheduling, clinical charting, billing, and patient management for dental practices of all sizes.

product.name: CS VoiceStack
product.description: An AI-driven telephony system that analyzes calls and provides insights to improve new patient conversion rates.

product.name: CS Pay™
product.description: An integrated payment processing solution that facilitates same-day patient collections and supports payment plans.

product.name: CS Membership™
product.description: A membership management platform that helps dental practices grow their patient base and increase case acceptance through plan management and integrated collections.

product.name: CareRevenue™
product.description: An outsourced dental revenue cycle management service that optimizes billing, collections, and cash flow for dental practices.

product.name: VirtualAssistant™
product.description: A remote front office support service that manages administrative tasks for dental practices to free up staff for patient care.
